restaurantName: Café in the Crypt, St Martin in the Fields
bio: Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea in one of London’s most unique locations – the vaulted crypt gallery beneath St Martin-in-the-Fields on Trafalgar Square.  The menu includes a selection of freshly made finger sandwiches, pastries, cakes, and of course traditional scones, served with Cornish clotted cream and preserves. Not forgetting a wide range of classic teas and tissanes to complete this most special of meals.  And to make it even more of an occasion, why not indulge yourself with a decadent glass of Champagne or Prosecco too!  Before you leave, don’t forget to browse the wealth of historical monuments housed within the original brick vaulted ceilings and stone floors... London’s history is literally at your feet!
pageTitle: Café in the Crypt, St Martin in the Fields
